Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here with me, because we’re about to dive into something truly special—a place where sharp wit meets the everyday absurd, and nothing is too ordinary to escape a little playful scrutiny.
Imagine seeing the world through a lens that questions everything, where even the most familiar moments—waiting in line, chatting with friends, or just marveling at the quirks of language—suddenly feel brand new, and a little bit hilarious.
That’s exactly the journey George Carlin invites us on in Napalm & Silly Putty. He takes the tangled mess of language, culture, and all those little human behaviors we take for granted, and turns them upside down—sometimes with a razor-sharp tongue, sometimes with a wink, but always with the kind of honesty that makes you stop and think.
So, what can you expect as we explore together? You’ll find moments that make you laugh out loud, others that leave you quietly reflecting, and plenty that remind us just how strange—and wonderful—modern life can be.
We're in for a mix of comedy, critique, and those little sparks of truth that hide in plain sight. Let’s jump in and see what we discover about ourselves, about society, and about the beautiful, ridiculous mess of being human.
